_comment: Copy this file to support_email.json and fill in your values. support_email.json is gitignored. Messages sent from the app's support popup always go to iranziresponse@gmail.com (hardcoded in config/settings.py) -- these are the credentials Orch uses to actually send that email, e.g. a Gmail account with an App Password (not your normal Gmail password: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords).
